---
name: Glyph proposal
about: Propose redrawing a glyph or glyph family from Roboto-derived to original
title: "[GLYPH] "
labels: glyph-design
---

**Glyph(s)**
Which character(s)? If proposing a family (e.g. n/m/u/r together), list them all — related glyphs should usually be redrawn together for visual consistency.

**Confirm this is next in sequence**
Check `ROADMAP.md` — is this glyph/family the current milestone's target? If not, explain why you think it should be prioritized differently.

**Spec reference**
Link the exact section of `docs/design/` this glyph needs to match.

**Approach**
Brief description of how you plan to construct it — which existing root systems it inherits from (e.g. "shares O's curve DNA," "uses H's terminal treatment"), and anything the spec leaves ambiguous that you'll need to make a judgment call on.

**Timeline**
Rough estimate — helps maintainers plan review capacity.
